text: Make a 6-second seamless loop for my website background: a calm mountain lake at dusk, with gentle ripples. Wide 16:9, camera staying still, no text or sound. Keep it subtle so I can put my own heading over it. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so please tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter or smaller way to do it?
